_doc: TEMPLATE ENCOUNTERS. 'party' lists character ids from characters/ (empty = use the active campaign party). 'enemies' instantiate templates from enemies/enemies.json with per-instance overrides. bossPhases fire once when the referenced enemy drops below hpBelow: they can announce (bannerText/narrationText), crush the party toward reducePartyToHpPct (executing anyone under executeBelowHpPct), and/or summon reinforcements. midBattleJoin adds a character to the party after N enemy actions.

encounters.name: Morning Concourse Rush Rally
encounters.description: A lively morning crowd and enthusiastic coupon collectors test your fast checkout rhythm!

encounters.name: Regional Audit Standoff
encounters.description: District Auditor Vance conducts an aggressive compliance inspection.

bossPhases.narrationText: Auditor Vance writes up a Level 3 writeup for out-of-stock tag placement!

encounters.name: Saturday Community Festival Rush
encounters.description: A bustling weekend crowd floods Action Alley for barbecue supplies and summer sales!

encounters.name: District VP Grand Inspection Showcase
encounters.description: District VP Vance inspects Store #1042 during peak velocity! Demonstrate supreme customer care and retail mastery.

bossPhases.narrationText: VP Vance flips open his leather portfolio to take note of your immaculate customer service!

encounters.name: Department Huddle Confrontation
encounters.description: The toxic slacker veteran deploys weaponized excuses, blame-shifting, and stall tactics! Stand your ground and expose the truth.

bossPhases.narrationText: The slacker attempts to stall the confrontation by claiming an emergency restroom break!

encounters.name: Loss Prevention Interrogation Standoff
encounters.description: Security Manager Clint deploys the Reid interrogation technique, falsified timeline logs, and felony termination threats! Break his manufactured narrative.

bossPhases.narrationText: Clint slides a typed confession statement and pen across the metal desk, threatening police arrest unless you sign!

encounters.name: The Executive Lockdown Showdown
encounters.description: Store Manager Henderson locks the executive office doors, wielding unhinged threats of career destruction, police intervention, and fabricated charges. Break his desperate reign of retail terror!

bossPhases.narrationText: Henderson slams his mahogany desk, waving termination notices and shouting that no associate leaves Store #1042 without signing an NDA!
